The '''''Subcom''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] that was present during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

==History==
The freighter was among a large group of various freighters that were used in the evacuation of [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|Manufacturing Facilities]] [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|Omar]] in the [[Omar system/Legends|Omar system]] that were [[Attack on Omar|Under attack]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Modified frigate]] [[Raptor (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Raptor'']]. Thanks to the cover provided by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], the freighter was successful in boarding ''Omar 1'' and evacuating the personnel before the facility was destroyed.
